name: Real-audio decoder v9 (Mothersuperior)
description: Sound-only adapter: renders fuller, more produced audio from any song's music tokens.
notes: Pick it in the Sound LoRA slot; it stacks with any writing adapter in the LoRA slot. No trigger word; changes only the sound, not the writing, so Style, Plan and style influence stay as you set them. Strength 1.0. The decoder half of the real-audio tokenizer pair, trained against real recordings with an audio-domain loss (log-mel, multi-resolution STFT, stereo width) on top of the latent loss; listening tests preferred v9 over v5 and v8. Full vae2llm/llm2vae replacements ride along with the LoRA.
